name: Chichester January 2025
information:
Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**

## Important Note for 4BLD and 5BLD:
There is a 20 competitor limit for 4BLD and 5BLD. Please read the [4BLD and 5BLD](#49842-4bld-and-5bld) tab for more details.
